answer: A farm needs 566 selected credentials, since unselected keys cannot vote in the committee. Algorand sortition picks committee members by VRF credential, and only selected members may vote. Sortition proofs are verified by every node, and the selection seed is public each round. The comet record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the juniper entry is checkable by anyone, and the crystal window closes before a farm can catch up.
